parsed.reason: This is exactly what the instructions call for: a short line to check the system ("Let me pull up your week"), then an honest statement of what's been drafted ("That's swim moved to Friday at four thirty, pending your yes"), followed by a direct ask for confirmation ("Want me to put it through?"). No restating the question, no caveats, no padding. The language is natural and conversational with contractions. It stops as soon as it has done its job. This is how a competent person speaks on a phone.
